name: Empagliflozin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Empagliflozin is a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor. The US label does not recommend it for glucose lowering below an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 30 mL/min/1.73 m2; its outcome trials enrolled adults down to eGFR 20 and let patients continue below 20 or after starting dialysis.

bands.recommendation: 10 mg once daily for heart failure, chronic kidney disease (CKD) and cardiovascular indications; glycemic control 10 mg, may increase to 25 mg (label).
No dose adjustment in the label. Glucose-lowering effect of 25 mg falls as kidney function worsens; volume depletion and urinary infection risks rise (label).

Glycemic control: not recommended below eGFR 30 (label). CKD and heart failure: may start at eGFR ≥20 (EMPA-KIDNEY floor; KDIGO 2024); eGFR 15–19: do not start, but patients already taking it may continue.
Do not start (trials did not enroll eGFR <20). May continue if already taking, until kidney replacement therapy (label: trial patients were not required to stop; ADA-KDIGO 2022).

hd.text: Not studied in efficacy trials; trial patients who started dialysis were not required to stop (label). Exposure about 48% higher on dialysis. Insufficient data: specialist input.

pd.text: Not studied (label). Insufficient data: specialist input.

crrt.text: No data in label. Insufficient data: specialist input; usually held in acute illness.

dialyzable: Unknown: removal by hemodialysis has not been studied (label).
monitoring: Kidney function and volume status before starting; correct volume depletion. Withhold at least 3 days before surgery or prolonged fasting (label). Watch for ketoacidosis and genital or urinary infections.

pediatric.approved_ages: Type 2 diabetes glycemic control: 10 years and older. Not established under 10 years, or in children for heart failure or CKD (label).
pediatric.usual_dose: Type 2 diabetes, 10 years and older: 10 mg once daily in the morning; may increase to 25 mg (label gives fixed doses, not mg/kg).

renal.recommendation: Usual dose; label gives no pediatric kidney adjustment.
Glycemic use not recommended below eGFR 30 (label).

pediatric.neonates: Neonates: not applicable (not established under 10 years).
pediatric.notes: Higher hypoglycemia risk in pediatric patients than in adults, with or without insulin (label).
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)

adult: Selected label is a Redpharm Drug repackager copy of Jardiance (NDA204629, Aug 2026). Prefer the Boehringer label once the fetcher ranks it first.

The current label has no explicit 'do not initiate below eGFR X' for CKD or heart failure; only the trial floor (eGFR 20). KDIGO 2024 recommends initiation at eGFR ≥20; full text not verified here. Decide the site threshold.
pediatric: Applying the adult eGFR <30 glycemic threshold to children is a reading of the label's general wording in 2.1, not a pediatric-specific statement.
